name: Tulasi
hook: Flower spikes taking over your tulasi? Pinch them.

steps.title: 6+ hours of full sun
steps.tip: Give it your sunniest south or west spot, sheltered from wind. Tulasi needs warmth and sun to thrive.

steps.title: Evenly moist, not soggy
steps.tip: Water the soil in the morning, not the leaves. Waterlogged roots rot, and drought makes it flower early.

steps.title: Warm nights only
steps.tip: It can spend summer outside once nights stay above 10°C. Bring it in before autumn turns cold.

steps.title: Pinch off flower spikes
steps.tip: Snip flower heads as they appear, and pick shoot tips so it stays bushy and keeps making leaves.

steps.title: A roomy, draining pot
steps.tip: Use a pot at least 20 cm wide and deep, filled with peat-free all-purpose potting mix that drains well.

steps.title: Gentle, balanced fertilizer
steps.tip: Potted plants run low on nutrients. Use balanced liquid fertilizer, not tomato fertilizer: it pushes flowers.

outro: Sun, warmth and regular pinching keep tulasi leafy all season.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Ocimum tenuiflorum
